defect: PDH process arrays return one item per process, but processes sharing an image name share one instance name; the sampler keyed items by name, so duplicates collapsed (120 of ~300 processes kept). Per-process CPU attribution (emulator/harness/telemetry/other) was therefore unreliable; the telemetry self-CPU read 0.0 in admission-2 although its own process-time counter showed ~0.47% of host.
unaffected: Processor total, available memory, commit, paging and scheduling-probe values come from separate scalar counters/threads and remain valid; both admission refusals (memory, commit, total CPU, paging) stand.

changes.diff: Pair cpu/pid/private arrays by position after verifying identical instance names; misaligned samples carry no attribution (processAttribution field).
Metrics skip unattributed samples; evaluation adds PROCESS_ATTRIBUTION_MISSING (<90% attributed samples) and guards absent CPU/telemetry metrics. THRESHOLDS unchanged.
